detail.body:
## Summary
- Add a `CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF` build arg to `docker/Dockerfile.ci.dev`, pinned to the tip of `NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend` branch `feat/1.29.0-megatron`.
- The ref is installed over the locked PyPI wheel after `uv sync`, inside the same `RUN` block.
- Skipped when the arg is empty or `IMAGE_TYPE=lts`.
- Docker-only: no change to `pyproject.toml` or `uv.lock`.
- Mirrors NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge#6427.

## Not yet verified
- Test image build (draft until done).
- That the branch's distribution name and version satisfy `nvidia-cudnn-frontend` (`pyproject.toml` pins 1.26.0 / `>=1.25.0`).
- That the `[cutedsl]` extra's dependencies are still present, since the git install uses `--no-deps`.

## Notes
- The commit is signed off (`-s`) but not GPG-signed yet.

detail.title: build: install cudnn-frontend from feat/1.29.0-megatron in CI dev image

files.patch:
@@ -95,6 +95,10 @@ COPY megatron/core/package_info.py /workspace/megatron/core/
 ARG IMAGE_TYPE=dev
 ENV IMAGE_TYPE=${IMAGE_TYPE}
 ENV NVTE_BUILD_NUM_PHILOX_ROUNDS=3
+# cuDNN Frontend is replaced after the sync below with this ref of NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend
+# (feat/1.29.0-megatron). Docker-only: outside pyproject.toml and uv.lock. Set empty to keep the
+# locked PyPI wheel. Skipped for the LTS image.
+ARG CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF=8924d4b41fd678ba1b98cd7f98bb78b222637573
 # Preserve Ampere support unless a caller selects narrower TE build targets.
 ARG NVTE_CUDA_ARCHS="80;90;100"
 # TE compiles each source's GPU targets one after another by default (nvcc --threads 1), so
@@ -183,6 +187,10 @@ RUN --mount=type=cache,id=uv-${TARGETARCH}-${NVTE_CUDA_ARCHS},target=/root/.cach
     rm -rf "${MAMBA_BUILD_DIR}"
     trap - EXIT
 
+    if [ -n "$CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF" ] && [ "$IMAGE_TYPE" != "lts" ]; then
+        uv pip install --no-deps --reinstall \
+            "nvidia-cudnn-frontend @ git+https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend.git@${CUDNN_FRONTEND_GIT_REF}"
+    fi
 EOF
 
 # Reuse the wheel without copying a second archive into the final image.
